description: Read one PAGE of records from a public open dataset. Give a dataset_id from city_datasets, an optional full-text search, an optional limit (default 10, maximum 50) and an optional offset to page through larger result sets. Datasets can hold hundreds of thousands of records, so a full page is usually NOT the whole answer: the response carries `truncated`, `matchingRecords` and a `nextOffset` to call back with. `source` is optional and defaults to "longbeach" (the City of Long Beach portal, DataLB). Returns the dataset schema plus the records, and names its source.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use the `nextOffset` from a previous call. 0 to 1000; deeper paging is not served (download the full file from the city portal instead).

search.description: Optional full-text search across the records

name: city_records
title: Read records from a public open dataset
